system.attitude: If your group faced a problem because you kept secrets from, or attempted to trick, a friend or ally, gain growth.
system.description:
You plot and scheme, creating cunning plans to ensure your success.

  • Attributes: Add +1 to Insight and +1 to any other attribute

  • Skills: Add +1 to Sneak or Talk.

  • Bonds: When you select bonds in the next step, at least one must be a rivalry.

  • Drive: When you create a Truth that represents a plan or scheme, regain 1 Spirit.

  • Exhaustion: Your cunning may tie you in knots when your schemes falter. When you become exhausted, add +1 to Threat if you choose any exhaustion other than Confused.

  • Attitude: If your group faced a problem because you kept secrets from, or attempted to trick, a friend or ally, gain growth.
